dedupe_keys.name: hurricane ida flood extent in southeastern pennsylvania

description: Rebecca Composto publishes a mapped flood extent for Hurricane Ida in four southeastern Pennsylvania counties on 2 September 2021. Zenodo serves a GeoJSON file directly under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The author derived it from ten-metre Sentinel-2 imagery and a Random Forest classifier. Its class field separates non-water, permanent water and flood water. An infrastructure modeller can compare simulated inundation against this observed-event classification or test exposure of roads and buildings. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this regional extent; the catalogue’s Hurricane Ian building imagery describes a different event and object. A limitation is that bridges, vegetation and other obstructions can hide flooded pixels, and some floods may be omitted or misclassified. The cited accuracy is a provider claim, not a check of this file. No GeoJSON was downloaded or overlaid on assets.
